title: CY50106: Electrochemical Methods Of Analysis
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: NilThe electrical double layer, charge transfer and kinetics of
electrode processes, transport phenomena, mechanism of electrode
reactionsInstrumentation: Voltage and current measurements, recording devices,
potentiostat, and galvanostat.Potentiostatic techniques: Cyclic and linear
sweep voltammetry, pulse voltammetry, chronocoulometry, chromoamperometry and
Bulk electrolysis.Indicator electrodes, optically transparent electrodes,
cells, solvents and electrolytes. Electrode reaction with coupled homogeneous
chemical reactions. Rate of electron-proton transfer. Electrogenerated
chemiluminescence, photoelectrochemistry. Book: Electrochemical Methods,
Fundamentals and Application, A.J. Bard, Fundamentals of Electroanalytical
Chemistry, P.S. Monk
